Name: Giant Blooms
Author: flowersinrevolt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Giant Blooms adds multiple flower head decor pieces to add to your game. In the package, there are decor, swags, and rug versions of the flower heads (so that you can still use the flowers but not have them block paths).  I've also included a season-changing rug/swag. In spring it's a daisy, in fall a sunflower! Enjoy the seasons. :) [/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Purchase at Robin's![/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Simple installation, but it does require SMAPI and Content Patcher. Put the folder in your mods folder. [/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]6 large flower head decor pieces (with small and large sizes)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]6 non-seasonal rugs[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]7 non-seasonal swags[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]1 seasonal swag/rug[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI and Content Patcher[/color][/size]
